description: Preset instantiation for other base units (chronology-engine §13): finer bases scale level 0, coarser ones drop levels, absolute moments move by the origin and scale (floored), overlay periods scale exactly, and formats of dropped levels go.
verification: Each expected definition is the preset file with the edits of §13 applied by hand: the kept level's templates become uniform counts of base units (its length in seconds × den / num), finer levels, their templates and the formats using them are removed, absolute t = origin + floor(seconds × den / num), and overlay periods are divided by the base unit (reduced fractions worked out by hand).

cases.note: one-second base units: the preset as written (origin 0)
k: the minute (60 s) is the first level lasting a multiple of k
a rational base unit: a minute is 40 units of 1.5 s; a second isn't a whole number of them
the overlays' epochs fall inside a day and are floored
the kʼin becomes level 0; the formats of hours, minutes and seconds go
no level lasts a multiple of 7 s in every template (29-day months, 365-day years)
the winal (20 days) is a whole number of units, but the Tzolkʼin and Haabʼ cycles count kʼins
